result.instructions: Tools for SMSBlast, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much prepaid balance is left on our SMSBlast account, and is our sender number verified?"; "Send 'Your appointment is tomorrow at 10:00' to +15551234567 from our verified number. Show me the text first."; "Opt +15551234567 out of our text messages, because they replied STOP.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SMSBlast data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smsblast_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smsblast_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smsblast_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. smsblast_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smsblast_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Read the SMSBlast account: organization id and name, prepaid balance, default sender number and whether that sender is verified. Use it to check the API key and the balance before sending. Free. GET /api/v2/me.

tools.name: smsblast_send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS or MMS
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS REAL MESSAGES AND BILLS THE ACCOUNT: send one SMS (or an MMS when mediaUrl is set) from a verified sender number to one recipient or up to 100 recipients in one call. Sent messages cannot be recalled. Before calling, show the user the exact sender, recipients and message text and get their confirmation. Recipients must have given consent to receive texts. SMSBlast adds 'Reply STOP to unsubscribe' to each message, unless the text already has opt-out wording or is a one-time passcode, and skips recipients who opted out. {{firstName}}-style placeholders are filled per recipient from the contact record. name applies only to a single recipient. POST /api/v2/sms/send.

anyOf.description: Phone number in E.164 format, for example +15551234567.

items.description: Phone number in E.164 format, for example +15551234567.

to.description: One E.164 number, or an array of up to 100 E.164 numbers.

from.description: Verified sender number you own, in E.164 format (see smsblast_get_account).

message.description: Message text. Required unless mediaUrl is set. Supports placeholders such as {{firstName}}, {{lastName}}, {{email}}, {{city}}.

name.description: Contact name. Only used when sending to one recipient; it sets that contact's first and last name.

mediaUrl.description: Public https image URL (jpg, png, gif or webp, up to 5 MB). Sends an MMS to every recipient at the MMS rate.

tools.name: smsblast_opt_out_contact
tools.title: Opt out contact
tools.description: WRITE: stop all further messages to one contact, matched by phone number in the account. Use it when a recipient asks to stop. Repeating the call is safe; the reply says whether the contact was already opted out. Returns 404 when no contact in the account has that number. POST /api/v2/contacts/opt-out.

number.description: The contact's phone number in E.164 format, for example +15551234567.
